length_role: Conditional nonlocal FRC scenario. The 40 mm interaction radius spans several 8 mm maximum aggregate sizes and is comparable to the reported 35 mm fibre length; neither fact identifies the radius. The separate 50 mm softening conversion length retains a previous material-point scenario. Both remain material/model parameters requiring response evidence. No quadrature-cell or element length is substituted, and the local law integral is not a claim about the global nonlocal fracture energy.

apparatus.role: Conditional linear series compliance using the previously fitted low-load machine-minus-jack slope. That fit did not identify frame/hydraulic compliance. The earlier affine seating offset is not applied as a discontinuity at the fixed reference. The recorded actuator increments are imposed and jack force is predicted; local LVDT and measured rod/support forces are observations.
apparatus.frame: Fixed external frame for the rod springs, trestles and actuator; jack motion is the work-conjugate weighted patch displacement relative to this frame. Lateral guides retain the existing in-plane rigid restraint.

parameter_role: Keep the existing two material inputs (top modulus and interface compression stiffness), 25 training conditions and four held queries. Fracture and apparatus values above define the current conditional scenario.
